text: The geographical breakdown of rental & maintenance services for textiles and hygiene and well-being appliances is as follows: France; Central Europe: Germany & Austria, Belgium & Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary & Slovakia and Switzerland; Scandinavia & Eastern Europe: Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Russia; UK & Ireland; Latin America: Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Mexico; Southern Europe: Spain & Andorra, Italy and Portugal. [#5741](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5741)

The European and Latin American markets for rental & maintenance services for textiles, as well as for hygiene and well- being appliances, mostly remain quite fragmented. [#5406](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5406)

In 2025, the Group exchanged views with 15 of its largest textile suppliers (representing more than 25% of spending related to direct suppliers) in order to discuss their climate commitments, assess their maturity on the subject and prepare future joint work. [#2946](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2946)

The Group is therefore developing partnerships with textile players in several of its markets in order to carry out pilot projects and explore different approaches, recycling technologies (including mechanical and chemical technologies) and opportunities (insulating materials, textile-to-textile, new innovative fibers). [#4607](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4607)

Similar initiatives are taking place in several European countries, where end-of-life workwear is channeled to mechanical recycling solutions to produce textile yarns or insulation materials for Industry. [#4644](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4644)

Elis purchases textile products and hygiene and well-being products mainly in Europe (37%), Asia (36%), Latin and South America (7.5%) for its local market, and Africa (nearly 14%). [#4026](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4026)

In particular, the textile industry has been identified as one of the three main sources of pressure on water and land use and among the top five in terms of raw material use and greenhouse gas emissions. [#2579](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2579)

In France (which accounts for 31% of the Group's textile waste by weight), the Group is conducting several trials aimed at developing "Textile to Textile" recycling for its workwear. [#4641](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4641)
The Group currently recycles 71.5% of its textiles. [#3026](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3026)
This contributes, in particular, to maintaining and developing textile industry knowledge and expertise in France. [#3945](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3945)

The "Other" category includes manufacturing entities (including French household linen designer and manufacturer Le Jacquard Franais and British hygiene appliance manufacturer Kennedy Hygiene), holding companies and the Group's activities in Asia (in Malaysia and Singapore). [#5348](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5348)
This panel includes textile suppliers representing nearly 30% of direct revenue. [#4103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4103)

United Kingdom British teams handed over 88,438 textile items to associations providing clothing and essential products to vulnerable people. [#203](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-203)

In particular, the Group shares its commitment and positions within the professional associations it belongs to, such as the French private business association (Association franaise des entreprises prives - AFEP), the French industrial textile services business association (Groupement des entreprises industrielles de services textiles - GEIST), and the European Textile Services Association (ETSA) across Europe. [#2788](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2788)

The Elis Group (the "Group") is an international service provider in 31 countries, offering solutions for the rental & maintenance of textile products and hygiene and well-being appliances. [#5546](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5546)

In Colombia, Elis has launched a textile recycling project in partnership with a local association that helps women in vulnerable situations rejoin the workforce. [#4624](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4624)
The Group has also strengthened its "textile-to-textile" recycling processes. [#4596](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4596)

For example, in Colombia, Elis was recognized at the Xposible trade fair for its linen reuse and recycling program, which enables recycling of 85% of textiles as part of a strategic partnership that also includes a community aspect, with linen donations to indigenous communities, young people's homes, and nursing homes. [#4595](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4595)
These suppliers are located in Europe, South America, North Africa and Asia. [#1966](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1966)

As a result, the Group organizes the collection of textile waste sorted at source for all its laundry facilities ( at linen, workwear, personal protective equipment, mats) in France (4,006 tons of textile waste) in order to simplify the collection process, centralize ows, and increase the proportion of textile items sorted at source and the amount recovered (recycling, reuse and recovery in the form of solid recovered fuel). [#4612](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4612)
